description.content:
End-to-end GraphQL + REST checks that run unchanged against BOTH the pre-modernization monolith (Django ORM order resolvers) and the post-modernization monolith (order-service FastAPI facade, steps 5/6 of the Strangler Fig migration in plans/00-master-plan.md).

Run with the `Monolith - Pre-Modernization` environment against a checkout of the old code (before commit `3fdb8f9c81`), and with `Monolith - Post-Modernization` against current `main` with the `local`/`monolith` docker-compose profile up. Folders 05 and 06 (order-service direct REST checks) auto-skip when `order_service_enabled` is not `true`, so the same collection works unmodified in both modes.

Run order matters — folders 01-03 create the checkout/order and store its id/token in collection variables that 04-06 read. Folder 06 mutates that order's status (ORD-04), so it runs last, after folder 04's queries have already captured the pre-transition state.
